title: Surge
subtitle: surge = 急升；激增；突然增加
description: surge = 急升；激增；突然增加

words.note: 當 surge 的重點是某個數值在短時間內大幅增加時，sharp rise 很自然，常見於價格、病例、需求、成本和比率。
words.example: The city recorded a sharp rise in electricity demand during the heatwave.

exercises.original: The city recorded a surge in electricity demand during the heatwave.
exercises.zh: 熱浪期間，該市錄得電力需求急升。
exercises.upgrade: sharp rise · 急升；大幅上升

options.explanation: heatwave 令需求在短時間內大幅增加，sharp rise in demand 是自然搭配。
表示由低位回復；原句沒有先前下跌背景。
只表示上落波動，方向不一定向上。
是最高點，不是上升過程。
可以表示增加，但未突出突然而明顯。

exercises.original: Hospitals reported a surge in emergency admissions during the outbreak.
exercises.zh: 疫情期間，醫院報告急症入院人數急升。
exercises.upgrade: sharp rise · 急升；大幅上升

options.explanation: outbreak 令 admissions 在短期內明顯增加，sharp rise 最精確。
gradual 表示慢慢增加，和 surge 的突然性不合。

exercises.original: The company faced a surge in shipping costs after fuel prices climbed rapidly.
exercises.zh: 燃油價格迅速上升後，公司面對運輸成本急升。
exercises.upgrade: sharp rise · 急升；大幅上升

options.explanation: climbed rapidly 清楚支持成本大幅急升。
表示較平穩持續，不符合急升。
表示升至某水平後趨平。

words.note: 當 surge 指經濟、銷售、信心或市場活動出現較正面、較持續的上升趨勢時，upswing 很自然。它通常不像 surge 那樣強調「突然」。
words.example: The tourism industry entered an upswing as international travel recovered.

exercises.original: The tourism industry experienced a surge as international travel recovered over several months.
exercises.zh: 隨着國際旅遊在數月內復甦，旅遊業出現上升趨勢。

options.explanation: over several months 表示較持續的正面回升，upswing 最合適。

exercises.original: Consumer confidence showed a surge as employment improved steadily through the year.
exercises.zh: 隨着全年就業情況穩步改善，消費者信心出現回升。

options.explanation: improved steadily through the year 強調持續正面趨勢。

exercises.original: Retail sales entered a surge after several weak quarters and then continued improving.
exercises.zh: 零售銷售在數季疲弱後進入回升期，其後繼續改善。

options.explanation: 先弱後持續 improving，是典型回升趨勢。

words.note: 當 surge 是非常突然、明顯，而且可能只維持很短時間時，spike 很精確，常見於流量、價格、病例、投訴和能源使用量。
words.example: The website experienced a spike in traffic after the announcement.

exercises.original: The website experienced a surge in traffic immediately after the announcement.
exercises.zh: 公告發布後，網站流量立即急升。

options.explanation: immediately after 指向非常突然的流量尖峰。

exercises.original: There was a surge in support calls for two hours after the software update failed.
exercises.zh: 軟件更新失敗後兩小時內，支援電話數量突然急升。

options.explanation: for two hours 表明短暫且由單一事件觸發。
通常較持續，而且多見於正面趨勢。

exercises.original: Energy use showed a surge at 6 p.m. when millions of people returned home.
exercises.zh: 下午六時，數百萬人回家時，能源使用量出現短暫急升。

options.explanation: 指定單一時間點 at 6 p.m.，很符合短時尖峰。
gradual 與 surge 的突然性不符。

words.note: 較口語和直接，表示數字、價格、銷售或數量突然上升。通常比 sharp rise 和 surge 稍不正式。
words.example: There was a jump in fuel prices at the start of the month.

exercises.original: There was a surge in fuel prices at the start of the month.
exercises.zh: 月初燃油價格突然上升。

options.explanation: jump in prices 是較口語的自然說法，表示突然提高。

exercises.original: The company reported a surge in online orders after the promotion began.
exercises.zh: 推廣活動開始後，公司報告網上訂單突然增加。

options.explanation: promotion 觸發訂單突然增加，a jump in orders 很自然。

exercises.original: The announcement caused a surge in the company's share price within minutes.
exercises.zh: 公告在數分鐘內令公司股價突然急升。

options.explanation: within minutes 顯示非常快速，jump in the share price 很自然。

words.note: 較正式，表示某種活動、需求、興趣、犯罪或病例出現一股快速而明顯的增加。
words.example: Hospitals reported an upsurge in respiratory infections during winter.

exercises.original: Hospitals reported a surge in respiratory infections during winter.
exercises.zh: 冬季期間，醫院報告呼吸道感染病例激增。

options.explanation: an upsurge in infections 是正式而自然的搭配。
感染病例「復甦」語意不合。

exercises.original: Police recorded a surge in bicycle thefts during the summer.
exercises.zh: 警方錄得夏季單車盜竊案件激增。

options.explanation: upsurge in thefts 是常見正式搭配，表示事件數量明顯增加。

exercises.original: The charity saw a surge in requests for food assistance after the factory closed.
exercises.zh: 工廠關閉後，慈善機構收到的食物援助申請激增。

options.explanation: factory closed 是明確觸發事件，令 requests 快速增加。
表示沒有明顯變化。 End of teaching material

falseSynonyms.zh: 增加不一定是急升 increase 只表示數量變多，可能很小、很慢；surge 通常強調升幅大而且較快。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A 2% increase is an increase, but it may be too small to describe as a surge.

falseSynonyms.zh: 增長不等於突然激增 growth 通常表示一段時間內持續增加，未必突然。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Steady growth over five years is different from a sudden surge in one month.

falseSynonyms.zh: 復甦不等於急升 recovery 表示由較差狀態回復；即使數字上升，也不一定速度很快或幅度很大。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The market showed a gradual recovery after the recession.

falseSynonyms.zh: 繁榮／急速擴張不等於所有 surge boom 通常表示一段較明顯、較持續的繁榮或快速擴張；surge 可以只是短時間的數量急升。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A housing boom may last for years, while a surge in enquiries may last only a few weeks.

falseSynonyms.zh: 高峰不等於上升過程 peak 是最高點；surge 是急升這個過程或現象。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Demand surged in December and reached its peak just before Christmas.

falseSynonyms.zh: 波動不等於上升 fluctuation 表示數值上落變化，可以向上也可以向下；surge 明確表示上升。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Daily fluctuations may include both rises and falls.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動詞和名詞結構不同 surge 可作動詞，也可作名詞。名詞常用 a surge in + 名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Prices surged overnight. There was a surge in prices overnight.

falseSynonyms.zh: 不及物和及物用法不同 rise 通常是不及物動詞或名詞；raise 是及物動詞，表示令某物上升。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Prices rose sharply. The company raised prices.
